messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
From 20 January 2027, what conformity assessment procedure will model RC-5 be required to undergo, and what is the reason for this?

response.text: A partire dal 20 January 2027, quale procedura di valutazione della conformità dovrà seguire il modello RC-5, e per quale motivo?
